name: Zersium rifle
description: A Zersium rifle was an extremely expensive and rare blaster rifle in use during the Dark Wars, a series of conflicts between remnants of the Sith Empire and the forces of the Galactic Republic that occurred after the Jedi Civil War. The high-powered and accurate rifle was partly manufactured from Zersium, a rare mineral that facilitated energy dissipation. The Zersium used in the blaster's construction allowed for the utilization of more powerful energy bursts without increasing the risk to the wielder.
